name: Odometer Overdrive
hook: Can your rental hatchback break the sound barrier before the desk clerk notices
tagline: You drive a rented compact car whose broken odometer spins faster and faster while billing receipt ticker-tape flies out the exhaust. Cash out to slide cleanly into the airport return lane with a zero-mile dispute form. If you crash, the dashboard erupts in smoke as an infuriated Hertz agent slams you with an astronomical invoice.
